senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָבַל)writhing, throes of birth, agony.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 98b:8">Snh. 98ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>חֶבְלוֹ של משיח</he> the sufferings which are to precede the advent of the Messiah.—Pl. <he>חֲבָלִים</he>, constr. <he>חֶבְלֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Niddah 31a:9">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ נקבה</he> the pains at giving birth to a female.
<cite ref="Niddah 31a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>וזהו ח׳ אשה</he> and this is the cause of woman’s throes.

senses.gloss: damage, injury. Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 8 ח׳ אשה לבעל the damages for a wife’s injury belong to her husband.
